div.div: 4 اعتدهُ , (S, O, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِعْتَادٌ; (S;) and ↓ عتّدهُ , (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَعْتِيدٌ; (S, K;) He made it ready, or prepared it, (S, O, Msb, K,) for a [future] day. (S, O.) The former verb occurs in the Kur xii. 31. (S, O, Msb.) Yaakoob says that the [former] ت in أَعْتَدْتُهُ is a substitute for the [former] د in أَعْدَدْتُهُ: and some say that أَعَدَّ is originally أَعْتَدَ; but others deny this. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
